decision: Sam extended functional per-case admission suspension until production go-live in AGENTS.md (PR #395). PM 47461a13, 07250f43 and eaacc66b directed the AR Credit Memo scope, ordinary merges and functional handoff. The source head is 3e89378f928427b6b16dbbff5c55908cc22ffbd2 on main ac3dd17a379368852af90fd4dedeee0855601b81. Independent exact review and trusted CI administrator digest registration are required.
purpose: Verify AR Credit Memo schema, permission seeding, currency rounding and remaining credit amounts, invoice void protection, concurrent confirmations, idempotent commands, credit applications and the shared refund balance contract.
data: Two MySQL schema checks verify permission seeds and credit/refund constraints in a freshly migrated private schema. Two HTTP cases use synthetic customers and a single opening invoice or a single shipped two-line order, with one matching posted return for source validation. Three in-memory tests cover per-line caps and shared credit balance locking.
concurrency: Existing routine server jobs and shard configuration. The HTTP case uses two concurrent confirmations for one original invoice to verify serialized credit limits. No new worker or job.
repetitions: Seven functional cases run once per applicable existing routine server run. Browser tests remain explicit local evidence and are outside this candidate.
thresholds: Exact money and schema constraints; permissions, idempotency and transactional outcomes match the assertions. Existing thresholds and coverage floors are preserved.
trigger: Existing server functional discovery only. No workflow, schedule, capacity or performance changes.
cost: Author measured the two HTTP cases together at 5.3 seconds in UTC and 7.3 seconds in Asia/Hong_Kong per timezone including setup; the other five cases total under one second locally. Remote CI critical-path impact is unmeasured.
